notes: Press release (Rule 425 / 14a-12) dated May 26, 2021 announcing board approval of a reorganization combining NXQ and NXR into NXP. The release does not state the exchange basis, expected closing time, meeting or record dates; proxy materials were 'expected to be filed in the coming weeks'. security_class 'common' rests only on the stated purpose (trading volume 'for common shares'); the release does not otherwise name the class exchanged. n_targets=2 is the count of funds named as combining into NXP. The filer (NXP) is the acquiring fund.
